contextNotes.text: +2 bonus on saving throws against effects with the air or electricity descriptors and effects that deal electricity damage. Ignore the first 30 ft of any fall when determining falling damage.
+2 shield bonus to AC while wielding a single Aldori dueling sword one-handed (+1 if two-handed); +2 on Initiative if you start combat with an Aldori dueling sword in hand.
+2 on saving throws against effects with the evil descriptor and on Constitution checks to stabilize when at negative hp.
When you use the Arcane Shield feat, you also gain a +1 insight bonus to AC for 1 round.
+2 bonus on Intimidate checks to demoralize opponents. Also adds piercing to your unarmed strike damage types and (with Boar Style) lets you demoralize as a free action when you tear flesh.
For 24 hours after meditating, +1 on Fortitude saves against poison, disease, starvation, and effects that would fatigue/exhaust you.
+4 competence bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid catching on fire or to put yourself out when on fire; also +1d4 fire damage with alchemical/nonmagical fire attacks (not magical or splash).
+2 on saving throws against effects that affect your composure (all mind-affecting spells, plus fear, nausea, and similar out-of-control effects); not physical effects like fatigue.
+2 on Will saves against attempts to scry on you or read your mind; +2 on Bluff to fool someone or pass secret messages (not to feint in combat).
+2 racial bonus on saving throws against diseases and ingested poisons (not other poisons); +2 on Survival to find food for yourself only.

+1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through the reach of a creature larger than you, when at least one ally with Circling Offense is also within that creature's reach.
In severe cold (below 0F), or for 1 round after taking cold damage: +2 on initiative checks.
While adjacent to an ally who also has this feat: +2 competence bonus to CMD (+4 if the creature attempting the maneuver is larger than both you and your ally).
While adjacent to an ally who also has this feat: +2 competence bonus on all combat maneuver checks (+4 to break free from a grapple).
While wielding a spiked chain: +1 shield bonus to AC (+2 while fighting defensively or using total defense).
While fighting defensively or using total defense: the fighting-defensively attack penalty is only -2, and you gain an additional +1 dodge bonus to AC.

Once per round, while fighting defensively with at least one hand free, against one melee attack you designate before the roll: +4 dodge bonus to AC (with total defense instead, deflect one melee attack that would hit, treating it as a miss).

When someone tries to discern your alignment, loyalties, or intentions (incl. detect thoughts, or your Bluff to send a secret message/feint being read): +2 on opposed skill checks and on Will saving throws to resist such effects.
+1 bonus on saving throws against effects with the emotion descriptor (the once/day reroll of a natural 1 is an uncomputable option).
+2 dodge bonus to AC when an opponent attacks you with a weapon from your chosen weapon group (+3 if you also have weapon training in that group).
+2 on Heal checks regarding evil outsiders or creatures that already have a demonic graft.
+2 on Knowledge (planes) checks to identify demons' powers, and +2 morale on caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of creatures you recognize as demons.
While using Dimensional Dervish, +4 on combat maneuver checks to bull rush, disarm, reposition, or trip.
After casting augury or divination, +1 sacred on all saving throws for 10 min/caster level.
+2 on saving throws against divine spells and the spell-like abilities granted by divine casting classes.
While in Djinni Style with remaining Elemental Fist attempts, +2 dodge to AC against attacks of opportunity.
While in Dragon Style, +2 on saving throws against sleep, paralysis, and stunning effects.
+1 on all saving throws against auras, breath weapons, SLAs, spells, supernatural abilities, and other special attacks of creatures with the dragon type.
+4 racial on Perception checks while underground, and on Survival checks to avoid getting lost in caverns and rocky areas.
+2 to CMD against disarm and sunder maneuvers directed at a wielded elven weapon (longbow, longsword, rapier, etc.).
+2 racial on Spellcraft checks made to identify the properties of magic items (also +2 racial on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance).
+2 racial on saving throws against spells or effects from one selected school of magic (chosen at feat selection; cannot be illusion).
While the third eye is open (1/day standard action, 1 minute), +8 on Perception checks to notice invisible creatures.
+1 on saving throws against effects with the emotion descriptor.
+2 to CMD against bull rush, grapple, overrun, reposition, and trip combat maneuvers.
+2 on Intimidate checks while using ferocity (fighting at negative hit points).
+2 on all saving throws against death effects (also: +1 damage taken from cold iron; +2/die from magical healing).
+5 racial on Disguise checks when impersonating the one chosen Medium race.
+2 on saves against spells with the fire descriptor.
+2 circumstance on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks when dealing with other goblins.
+2 on all saving throws against fear effects.
+1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from the chosen group (and +1 to your spell/ability save DCs vs them).
+2 morale on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, and on Escape Artist/grapple checks to escape a grapple or bonds.
While raging, +4 competence on saving throws against spells/effects with the good descriptor.
+2 to AC against critical hit confirmation rolls while using the selected shield type (stacks with Shield Specialization).
+2 dodge bonus to AC while in a terrain you chose with Attuned to the Wild.
+2 on saves against spells and special abilities that cause you to become staggered or stunned.
+1 on all Will saves made to resist enchantment effects.
+1 morale bonus on saving throws while within 30 feet of at least two other hobgoblins.
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to bull rush a foe.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to bull rush you.
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to drag a foe.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to drag you.
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to grapple a foe.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to grapple you.
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to overrun a foe.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to overrun you.
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to reposition a foe.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to reposition you.
+4 on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework (replaces the stonecunning Perception bonus).
+2 on combat maneuver checks made to sunder an item.
+2 to CMD when an opponent tries to sunder your gear.
After slaying an intelligent creature, +1 on attack rolls and caster level checks for 1 minute (does not stack with itself).
+1 on saving throws against effects with the emotion descriptor (stacks with Fearless Curiosity).
+2 racial bonus on saving throws against any effect causing the nauseated or sickened condition and against all ingested poisons (but not other poisons).
+2 on Survival checks to find food for yourself.
+2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.
While using this style, after a successful Knowledge check to ID a creature, +2 on saving throws against that creature's attacks.
While using this style, after a successful Knowledge check to ID a creature, +2 dodge bonus to AC against that creature's attacks of opportunity.
+4 on combat maneuver checks against enemies denied their Dexterity bonus to AC.
+2 bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.
+4 bonus on Climb checks to catch yourself or another creature while falling.
+4 bonus on saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall prone (e.g. earthquakes); does not apply to CMD vs bull rush/trip.
+1 bonus on skill checks when your actions would directly lead to freeing prisoners or slaves.
+1 dodge bonus to AC against ranged attacks.
+4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving out of or within a threatened area; lost when you lose your Dex bonus to AC.
+4 dodge bonus to AC against the opponent whose space you entered (via Monkey Style after a Stunning Fist hit).
+5 racial bonus on Intimidate checks made against creatures of the humanoid type.
+1 bonus on all saves against mythic spells and effects (only if you become a mythic creature).
+2 bonus (+4 with 10+ ranks) on Perception checks while in unclaimed wilderness or land under your control.
+2 bonus (+4 with 10+ ranks) on Stealth checks while in unclaimed wilderness or land under your control.
+2 bonus (+4 with 10+ ranks) on Survival checks while in unclaimed wilderness or land under your control.
+2 bonus on saving throws to resist spells/effects that use negative energy, cause negative levels, or cause ability damage/drain/penalties.
+2 bonus on drag and reposition combat maneuver checks made using your net.
+2 morale bonus on Acrobatics checks while fighting within an area of magical darkness.
+2 morale bonus on Intimidate checks while fighting within an area of magical darkness.
+10 bonus on Disguise checks to disguise yourself as a human (no penalty for the cross-race disguise).
+2 bonus on Survival checks when outside your home plane.
+2 bonus on attacks of opportunity provoked by a larger (1+ size category) creature's combat maneuver against you; if no AoO is allowed against that maneuver, +2 to CMD against it instead.
+4 sacred bonus on saving throws against poison.
+2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity from opponents that are not adjacent to you.
+10 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks to impersonate a specific individual when using your racial change shape ability.
+2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks when interacting with good creatures.
+4 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence creatures of your chosen subtype (dwarf, elf, gnome, halfling, human, or orc).
+2 bonus on saving throws against fire attacks and spells with the fire or light descriptor
+4 bonus on Bluff checks made to pass secret messages (not other Bluff uses)
+4 competence bonus on Perception checks for the duration of your bond senses ability (while sharing your eidolon's senses)
+1 on all saving throws per adjacent ally who also has this feat (maximum +4)
+2 to AC against critical hit confirmation rolls (selected shield type only)
+3 on Sense Motive checks to resist a foe's feint; opponents gain no flanking attack bonus against you
+4 on Perception checks to detect shaken/frightened/panicked creatures using scent
+1 shield bonus to AC while using Snapping Turtle Style with at least one hand free
+1 on combat maneuver checks against, and +1 to CMD against, an opponent you alone threaten
+4 on saving throws against spider web special attacks and web-like spells
+4 on Perception checks to act in the surprise round while in your attuned (Attuned to the Wild) terrain
+4 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities (replaces dwarf hardy)
+1 on all saving throws against fear effects
+2 on Perception checks while in a primarily underground or mountainous environment (+4 with 10+ ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering)).
+4 on Bluff checks to lie or conceal your feelings/true motives (not to feint or pass secret messages); the DC to read you with Sense Motive is 25.
+2 on all saving throws against electrical effects.
+2 on Acrobatics checks to keep your balance.
+2 on Reflex saves to avoid falling.
+1 circumstance bonus to AC for each adjacent ally who also has this feat.
While fighting with a falcata and buckler: shield bonus to AC increases by +1 and you gain +2 on Acrobatics checks.
While using Tiger Style, +2 to CMD against bull rush, overrun, and trip maneuvers.
+1 on CMB checks to trip a larger foe while an ally with Topple Foe flanks it (scales with additional flanking allies and consecutive-round trip attempts).

+2 on all saving throws to resist the effects of fire or heat (also grants fire resistance 5; a swift action raises resistance to 10 and the save bonus to +4 until your next turn at the cost of your Dex bonus to AC).
In your chosen settlement: +1 dodge bonus to AC against undesirable elements (criminals/ruffians).
+2 to CMD against all trip attacks (while hanging from a branch you also gain +2 to CMD vs bull rush, drag, and reposition).
Also grants one Mammoth Lords tribe sub-benefit (Bearpelt, Greattusk, Ice Chasm, Night Hunt, Raptorscale, or Slothjaw) chosen at selection — a small save/skill/speed bonus that varies by tribe.
+1 shield bonus to AC while wielding a double weapon or two weapons; increases to +2 while fighting defensively or using total defense.
+2 shield bonus to AC while wielding a double weapon or two weapons (not natural/unarmed); increases to +4 while fighting defensively or using total defense.
+3 shield bonus to AC while wielding a double weapon or two weapons (not natural/unarmed); increases to +6 while fighting defensively or using total defense.
+4 dodge bonus on Acrobatics checks to move past opponents larger than you without provoking.
+2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or within a larger opponent's threatened area.
+1 on saving throws against your chosen foe and its known minions.
+2 on saving throws against spells or effects originating from demon worshipers and creatures of the demon type.
+4 on Perception checks while your eidolon is within your reach (and not helpless/unconscious); +8 if you have 10+ ranks in Perception.
+2 on concentration checks made to cast a spell or use a spell-like ability when casting defensively or while grappled.
+4 on Survival checks made to predict the weather.
+1 on saving throws to avoid the effects of extreme weather.
+2 bonus to AC against charge attacks.
+2 on saving throws against the hexes, spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities of witches and hags.
+2 on combat maneuver checks to trip made as part of an attack of opportunity.
+2 competence on Survival checks at altitudes of 5,000 ft or higher (and you are automatically acclimated to high altitude).
+5 on Use Magic Device checks to use divine spell-trigger/spell-completion items or to emulate a divine class feature.
+2 insight on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, Knowledge, Perform (oratory), and Sense Motive checks involving a divine spellcaster or a cleric-like outsider.
+2 racial (+4 at 10th level) on Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand while you have at least one unused gnome spell-like ability.
